_instance_comment: State lives in state/carry/btc-hl/ — deliberately distinct from the OKX carry's state/carry/btc/.
_hl_comment: Agent key comes ONLY from env (HL_PRIVATE_KEY or HL_CARRY_PRIVATE_KEY in /etc/trading-bot/carry-hl-btc.env). DEDICATED-WALLET design (2026-07-20): HL gates createSubAccount behind $100k cumulative traded volume (master had $6.3k), so the carry runs on its own wallet — hl_account_address = the dedicated wallet 0x, hl_sub_account_address stays null, hl_dedicated_account_confirmed=true (set by scripts.carry_hl_go onboard). That wallet must run NO other lane. Agent keys cannot sign user-signed actions (usdClassTransfer gets attributed to the agent's own account — verified on testnet 2026-07-20), so the operator does the spot/perp split of a deposit in the HL UI; scripts.carry_hl_go only verifies balances. Any non-DRY mode FAILS CLOSED at startup unless (a) an account address is set (the agent wallet's own address is never used) AND (b) hl_sub_account_address is set OR hl_dedicated_account_confirmed=true — a carry unwind is a reduce-only market_close on the carry coin, and on a shared account (e.g. hl-xsectional trades BTC on the master) it would otherwise read/flatten that lane's book.
_mode_comment: GREEN-BUTTON flipped ON 2026-07-20 (trailing-90d +5.49%/yr > +5%). Ships DRY_RUN until funded; activation = scripts.carry_hl_go go (sets sizing from actual balances, flips dry_run=false + allow_live=true + env HL_CONFIRM_LIVE=YES, restarts carry@hl-btc). Live needs all of those AND per-leg notional <= live_max_usd; okx_demo must stay false (HL has no demo venue — the runner rejects it). Testnet paper = hl_network=testnet + dry_run=false + allow_live=true.
_leverage_comment: L<=2 without top-up automation per HL-CARRY-STUDY; never >4.
_cadence_comment: Hyperliquid funding settles HOURLY: native hourly samples, 24*365=8760 settlements/yr, 90d window = 2160 samples. Do NOT aggregate to 8h. The runner refreshes the window WHOLESALE from funding HISTORY once per settlement (one sample per settled hour) — never per 60s cycle — so 2160 samples really is trailing 90d.
